# neuron v0.1.8 — function rows function!1!!!1!

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). The installer and portable ZIP include the tray app and CLI. The binaries are unsigned. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit.

function rows exist to neuron. *should have been there, but…* welcome home. well, welcome fn ❤️

## What's better

- **Fn keys.** neuron holds keyboards in driver mode for the M keys, and that quietly broke the Fn row. Fn+F-key volume, media, sleep and game mode work again on the BlackWidow Chroma V2, and V3/V4-class media keys should work too. I don't own those, so tell me how it goes!
- **Per-device binds.** Binding a regular key on one keyboard now fires the bind, instead of typing the key late.
- **HyperShift.** Shifted keys only shift while you hold the shift key, and they stop typing their normal key.
- **Reliability.** No silent safe mode and no frozen window on quit when your wireless mouse is asleep. Macros don't get killed on a busy machine, and a device you plug in mid-session works everywhere without a restart.
- **Sharing setups.** A shared device file can't attach commands to keys anymore.

## Install

Use the installer, or unpack the portable ZIP into a writable folder and run `neuron-app.exe`.

Still the Windows beta. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.8/docs/STATUS.md).

- `neuron-v0.1.8-windows-x86_64-setup.exe`
